info.title: Contacts built-in app
info.description: Project-local shared contacts, business-card scanning and who-knows-whom. Bearer user identity or exchanged access-key assertions. GET requires contacts:read for access keys; all other methods require contacts:write. Keys never inherit admin roles. JSON errors use {error,message}. All timestamps are UTC RFC 3339.

post.description: At most 5 MiB of JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC. JPEG/PNG are normalized to JPEG with a maximum 1600px edge. With a configured splitter and caller bearer, detection has a 15-second timeout. Two or more filtered regions create a sheet and ordered pending cards in one transaction; contactId is rejected with sheet_with_contact. Detection errors, unavailable splitting or fewer than two regions produce one card with sheet null. With contactId on a single card, links immediately and skips OCR (ocrState unavailable). Pending cards are enqueued after commit. Card linkage records a contact change and increments its version under the transaction lock without requiring If-Match.

404.description: Not found or hidden by private visibility

post.description: Card owner or admin. Explicitly confirmed contacts are active regardless of OCR confidence; changes have source member and newly created contacts have registeredBy member. Extractions never change. A newly created contact starts at version 1 with one creation change. Recomputes encounters on old and new contacts; existing contacts receive a version increment and one change under the transaction lock. No If-Match header is required.

post.summary: Undo a card registration (owner or admin)
post.description: Detaches the card and sets decision to NeedsReview with decisionReason unlinked. Recomputes encounters and archives an auto-created contact only when it has no other cards and no human edit. Extractions remain immutable. Access keys are refused with 403 key_not_permitted.

404.description: Not found or hidden by private visibility

post.description: Card owner or admin. No extractor configured returns 409 ocr_unavailable; a completed or pending card cannot be retried. Resets decision and decisionReason to null, preserving the previous extraction until a new immutable extraction is recorded. Re-enqueues OCR with the caller's fresh Authorization bearer, held only in process memory and consumed when the worker processes the card. If the process restarts or another replica claims the card without that bearer, OCR becomes unavailable without a gateway call; retry this operation to supply a fresh bearer. A gateway 401 remains a failed OCR result with the error OCR gateway rejected the caller (401).

ocrModel.description: Project OCR model override. Empty uses CONTACTS_LLM_MODEL, or the gateway default when the release model is also empty. No Unicode whitespace or control characters.

Extraction.description: Immutable OCR interpretation. Every re-run appends a new extraction; registration never changes its fields.

model.description: Model reported by the gateway, or an empty string if unknown.

Sheet.description: The original normalized image that yielded multiple business cards.

bbox.description: [x1,y1,x2,y2] in pixels of the normalized sheet image.

ContactPatch.description: Omitted or null properties are unchanged. Empty strings clear optional scalar values; empty arrays clear emails/phones.

model.description: Effective Settings override or release model; empty delegates to the gateway default.

releaseModel.description: Release default from CONTACTS_LLM_MODEL; empty uses the gateway default.

models.description: Gateway models visible to the caller bearer. Cached with locality for 60 seconds per bearer and effective model; empty on errors.

local.description: True when owned_by is neither openai nor anthropic.

True when the effective model (or first model when unset) has owned_by other than openai or anthropic in the gateway models response. Probed with the caller bearer, cached per bearer and effective model for 60 seconds; failures return false.

sheetSplit.description: True when a sheet splitter is configured. Detection failures fall back to a single card.
